invitation.subject: You're invited to Elite Tech Academy
invitation.body:
Hello {firstName},

An account has been created for you at Elite Tech Academy.
Set your password using this link (valid for {hours} hours, single use):

{link}

If you did not expect this email, you can ignore it.

Elite Tech Academy · Scientia et Innovatio

passwordReset.subject: Reset your Elite Tech Academy password
passwordReset.body:
Hello {firstName},

We received a request to reset your password.
Use this link within {minutes} minutes (single use):

{link}

If you did not ask for this, ignore this email; your password stays the same.

Elite Tech Academy · Scientia et Innovatio

bookingConfirmed.subject: Your session is confirmed
bookingConfirmed.body:
Hello {firstName},

Your session with {mentorName} is confirmed for {when} ({timeZone}).
The meeting link will appear in your dashboard before the session:

{link}

You can reschedule or cancel free of charge up to 24 hours before.

Elite Tech Academy · Scientia et Innovatio
